subject: general
question: The song of lament 'the life has gone out of the body' is associated with Nawab ________ of the State of Awadh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wajid Ali Shah.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The song of lament 'the life has gone out of the body' is associated with Nawab **Wajid Ali Shah of the State of Awadh.**
 
• The exile of the ruler of the Awadh kingdom was termed as "The life has gone out of the body".
 
• Awadh is known in British historical texts as Avadh or Oudh.
 
• Awadh is a region of Uttar Pradesh
 
• The traditional capital of Awadh was Lucknow, also the station of the British Resident, which now is the capital of Uttar Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Why it was termed as "The life has gone out of the body"?
 
• Awadh was annexed by the British on the plea that the region was being misgoverned
 
• The British thought that the Nawab was not popular but on the contrary, he was very popular.
 
• People considered it as “the life has gone out of the body”.
 
• The removal led to an emotional upheaval among the people of Awadh.
